description.value: BC Liquor Store — branded BCLIQUOR — is one of 198 provincial government-operated retail outlets across British Columbia, offering an extensive selection of wine, spirits, beer, coolers, and ciders. The Fairfield Road location sits in one of Victoria's most cycle-friendly residential neighbourhoods, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists heading through the area. Staff are described as knowledgeable about product selection and pairings.
